Full suite, biome, tsc numbers match the implementer's within run-time noise. Red-first claims (old ledger answered resend attempt 1 on the fifth claim; old P14 hung on the post-cap pause; the processes lock failed on the console.error count) are consistent with the diff — the pre-#1120 ledger deleted the entry at the cap — but were not re-executed against the old code: the ledger diff is the evidence.
